engineering_note: No design commitment has been made. This is intentional. Premature commitment to a concept is how teams end up rebuilding in Week 5.

engineering_log.title: Season Kickoff
engineering_log.notes: BONSAI.exe team kickoff meeting. Introduced the game, discussed strategies, and assigned initial roles.

coaches.name: Coach Michael
coaches.bio: I’m a science guy at heart, with a background in biotechnology and cancer research, but I’m just as passionate about coaching and helping young people discover what they’re capable of. Outside of work, I’m an Assistant Scoutmaster and volleyball coach, and I love great food, travel, and new adventures. Fun fact: I once made it into the Guinness Book of World Records for helping make the world’s longest sushi roll! I’m super excited to be part of Bonsai.exe this season and can’t wait to see what this team can accomplish together, building, experimenting, tackling challenges, learning from our mistakes, and most importantly, having a ton of fun along the way!

coaches.name: Coach Amy
coaches.bio: I have an undergraduate degree in engineering, but have worked in finance for the past 30 years. I am super excited to be part of this amazing group of teens and coaches.

coaches.name: Coach Steven
coaches.bio: Hi, I'm Steven. I like building things. Built some startups, exited a few, trying to build more. Spent years as a strategy consultant. Worked extensively in the US and China. Trained as an electrical engineer but can barely change a light bulb. What I work on now: Doodling with LLMs, building prototypes in a range of fields, such as agentic overlays for legacy ERP systems, neural knowledge retention for research labs, agentic assistants for skilled tradesmen, etc. Let's see what works out.

coaches.name: Izzy
coaches.bio: This is my 4th year of being a programmer in FTC and I'm on team 19458 Equilibrium.exe.

team.name: Jason
team.role_long: My name is Jason. I have minor FIRST experience through helping with other teams, but this is my first year with BONSAI.exe. I, along with Cliff, program the robot. I hope to have a great season with the team.

team.name: Lucas
team.role_long: My name is Lucas, I’m in the 7th grade, and a team member on BONSAI.exe. I’m the one of the team members who does CAD on the team

team.name: Nicholas

team.name: Cliff
team.role_long: My name is Cliff I’m in 8th grade. I will be the driver and also do some software. I have previous experience with software but this will be my first year competing in FTC. I am excited to have a great season with Bonsai.exe

team.name: Elliott
team.role_long: My name is Elliott Kuo, 8th grader at Robert Frost Middle School. I will be a part of our hardware team this year, and i'm so excited for our first FTC season.
